data.long_meaning: Derived from the ancient Greek 'Hendon', meaning 'strong, steadfast one'. In Christian tradition, this name carries spiritual significance as a reminder of God's unwavering love and strength. The name Henden carries the meaning “Strong, steadfast one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Henden usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, steadfast one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In the context of Christianity, the name 'Henden' embodies spiritual significance as a reminder of God's unwavering love and strength. This name is also a reminder of the ultimate strength and steadfastness of God, who remains constant and loving despite the ever-changing world around us.
